HOW TO ADD AN AGE-BASED DISCOUNT TO THE APPOINTMENT BILL (SHOWS ON PDF TOO)
==============================================================================

Goal: patients below age 10 get 10% off their consultation bill.
The discount amount must be visible on the bill / PDF, not just a smaller total.

This guide only explains the steps. No code has been changed yet.


WHERE THE BILL IS BUILT TODAY (for context)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- apps/appointment/models.py
    Appointment.patient_age   -> already stores the patient's age. Nothing to add here.
    Payment.amount            -> the total the patient pays (department fee + doctor fee).

- apps/appointment/views.py, function _create_appointment_payment_record()
    This is where "amount" is worked out and the Payment row is created,
    for both online payment and cash-at-reception bookings.

- apps/appointment/views.py, function download_appointment_bill()
    This builds the PDF using templates/frontend/appointment/appointment_bill_pdf.html

- templates/frontend/appointment/appointment_bill_pdf.html
    The actual PDF layout (uses xhtml2pdf, so keep the CSS simple).


STEP 1: Add a new field to store the discount amount
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In apps/appointment/models.py, inside class Payment, add one field next to "amount":

    discount_amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=8, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    # money taken off for the age discount. 0 means no discount was given.

Why a new field: if you only shrink "amount", the bill will show a smaller
total but nobody can tell WHY it is smaller. Keeping the discount in its own
field lets the PDF print a separate "Age Discount" line.

Then run, in the terminal:
    python manage.py makemigrations appointment
    python manage.py migrate

Old, already-paid appointments will just get discount_amount = 0, which is fine.


STEP 2: Work out the discount when the Payment row is created
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Still in apps/appointment/views.py, inside _create_appointment_payment_record(),
find this existing line:

    fee_amount = department_fee + doctor_fee  # total the patient pays

Right after it, add the age check:

    # children below 10 years old get 10% off the total fee
    discount_amount = 0
    if appointment.patient_age < 10:
        discount_amount = fee_amount * Decimal('0.10')  # 10% of the total
    fee_amount = fee_amount - discount_amount  # final amount after discount

(Decimal is already imported at the top of this file, so nothing new to import.)

Then update the Payment.objects.create(...) call a few lines below to also save it:

    Payment.objects.create(
        appointment=appointment,
        amount=fee_amount,               # this is now the amount AFTER discount
        discount_amount=discount_amount, # how much was taken off, so the bill can show it
        doctor_fee_amount=doctor_fee,
        ...keep the rest of the fields exactly as they are now...
    )

To use a different rule later (different age, different %), only these few
lines change - nothing else in the project needs to know about it.


STEP 3: Fix the fee breakdown on the PDF view
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In download_appointment_bill(), this existing line works out the department
fee by subtracting the doctor's fee from the total:

    department_fee = payment.amount - payment.doctor_fee_amount

Problem: after Step 2, payment.amount is already AFTER the discount, so this
line would now show a wrong (too small) department fee. Fix it by adding the
discount back first:

    amount_before_discount = payment.amount + payment.discount_amount
    department_fee = amount_before_discount - payment.doctor_fee_amount
    doctor_fee = payment.doctor_fee_amount

Then pass discount_amount into the template too:

    html = render_to_string('frontend/appointment/appointment_bill_pdf.html', {
        'appointment': appointment,
        'payment': payment,
        'department_fee': department_fee,
        'doctor_fee': doctor_fee,
        'discount_amount': payment.discount_amount,
    })


STEP 4: Show the discount line on the PDF
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In templates/frontend/appointment/appointment_bill_pdf.html, inside the
"items" table, after the doctor's fee row, add:

    {% if payment.discount_amount %}
    <tr>
        <td>Age Discount (10%)</td>
        <td class="amount">- Rs. {{ payment.discount_amount }}</td>
    </tr>
    {% endif %}

The "Total Amount" row at the bottom already prints {{ payment.amount }},
which is the final discounted total, so that row needs no change.


STEP 5 (OPTIONAL): show it on other pages too
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Right now the discount will already be correct everywhere, because
payment.amount is the real final amount - screens like the patient's
"My Appointments" bill view, the dashboard payment list, and revenue
reports all just read payment.amount as before.

If you also want an explicit "Age Discount: Rs. X" line on a screen
(not just the PDF), pass payment.discount_amount into that view/template
the same way as Step 3-4. Good candidates, if wanted later:
    - templates/dashboard/appointment_management/view.html
    - templates/frontend/payment/history.html


NOTES
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- To change the age cutoff (e.g. below 12 instead of below 10), change the
  "if appointment.patient_age < 10:" line in Step 2.
- To change the percentage (e.g. 15% instead of 10%), change Decimal('0.10')
  to Decimal('0.15') in Step 2.
- The discount is decided once, at booking time, using the age typed into
  the "patient_age" field on the booking form - no extra form field needed.
- Money math always uses Decimal (never float), so amounts stay exact -
  this project already does this everywhere else too.
